comment: When the frozen JavaScript fallback of a release must be rebuilt (build-release-matrix.sh). A trigger fires when a listed profile field differs from the frozen build's sidecar, or when a listed path changed between the commit the frozen build came from and the tree being released. security never fires by itself: name it with --js-trigger security.

worker.comment: One singleplayer Worker bootstrap serves both server runtimes of a site (build-pages-site.py), so the frozen JavaScript server must speak the current page/Worker protocol.
